placementHint: Choose the current semester and home department. Subject access still requires enrollment in an offering.
structureDescription: Create and edit faculties, departments, academic years, semesters and subject definitions.
invalidDates: Check date order and keep semesters inside their academic year.
invalidParent: Choose valid academic records and active university accounts.
offeringsDescription: Offer a subject in a semester, assign its instructor, enroll students and set class times.
capacityExceeded: Enrollment would exceed capacity, or capacity is below the existing roster.
immutableOffering: An existing offering's subject and semester are fixed. Create another offering to change them.
enrollmentHint: Choose active students who are not already enrolled. Existing academic records are preserved.
makeCurrent: Set this as the selected students' current semester
invalidTime: Use valid times and an end time after the start time.
scheduleConflict: These class times overlap for an instructor, room or enrolled student.
settingsDescription: Set the university's grading scale, attendance rules and weekend days.
scaleHint: Cover 0–100 without gaps or overlaps. Each upper bound is exclusive except 100.
invalidScale: Grade ranges must cover 0–100 without gaps or overlaps.
unlockDescription: Only university administrators can reopen locked gradebooks. Published results remain visible to students.
unlockConfirm: Unlock {{name}} and allow authorized staff to edit its published grades?
teacherDescription: Manage teacher credentials, account access and academic permissions.
deactivateDescription: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be unable to sign in. Their academic records will be preserved.
permissionsDescription: These permissions apply only to this teacher's assigned classes. Publishing grades is a separate grant. Unlocking grades remains administrator-only.
title: Student accounts
description: Issue university accounts and manage student identity and access.
resetDescription: Issue a new unique password for {{name}}? Their current password will stop working. Give the new credentials directly to the account holder.
generatedPasswordNote: A unique password and university ID will be generated when you create this account. Copy the credentials and give them directly to the account holder.
credentialsDescription: Copy these credentials now. The password will not be shown again after you close this window.
copyError: Copy is unavailable. Select the email and password fields to copy them manually.
handoverNote: Give this email and password directly to the account holder. Only a university administrator can change student or teacher names, emails and passwords.
emailTaken: This email address already belongs to another university account.
teacherActivityDescription: Current course assignments, teaching materials and grade entries across all semesters. Select a teacher to manage their classes. Latest activity reflects materials, grade entries and announcements for their currently assigned courses.
deleteRecordDescription: Delete {{name}}? Records with linked academic data must be kept.
recordInUse: This record has linked academic data. Remove its dependencies first; student records are preserved.
